name: LiteLLM
tagline: LiteLLM is an open-source Python library and proxy server that provides a single, standardized interface for calling over 100 LLM APIs including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-source models. It handles retries, load balancing, cost tracking, and fallbacks across providers.
